critique: The exact minimax characterization and attainment are proved only for compact iid-Gaussian local neighborhoods; over the full stationary mixing class the note proves a uniformly root-n projection band and a one-sided local lower bound, but no matching globally honest attaining procedure. The TL;DR's claim to compute the exact local value is defensible only in the computable-limit sense: each finite LP supplies an approximation, and the note reports no nontrivial multidimensional numerical computation beyond the binary hinge calculation. Practical significance is also limited by the block-stable fixed-rank model and the absence of a worked synthetic-control application or computational performance evidence for the exponentially large acceptance-subset programs. These restrictions keep the package below flagship and below the strongest leading-journal benchmark, but they do not negate the delivered field-level local minimax theorem.
